{{Quote|What about Darth Igrol? He is Sith, and he has served longer than anyone except Darth Xedrix.|The Sith Lord Scourge|<ref name="Revan" />}}
'''Darth Igrol''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who became a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and served on the [[Dark Council]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He ascended to the twelve-member ruling body<ref name="Revan" /> sometime between [[3984 BBY|3984]] and [[3974 BBY]], and by the [[3954 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the first half of ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' in [[3954 BBY]], and [[Darth Nyriss]] is said to have joined the [[Dark Council]] twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the start of the novel. [[Darth Xedrix]], in turn, joined the Council ten years prior to Nyriss, meaning the two joined in [[3984 BBY|3984]] and [[3974 BBY]] respectively. Darth Igrol is stated to be the second-longest serving member of the Council in 3954 BBY, joining after Xedrix but prior to Nyriss, so he must have joined between 3984 and 3974 BBY.</ref> he had served on the Council longer than any other member besides [[Darth Xedrix]].<ref name="Revan" />

Igrol resided<ref name="Revan" /> in a [[Darth Igrol's estate|lavish estate]]<ref name="Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Fels]] instead of the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], though he was summoned to the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] with eight other Dark Councilors<ref name="Revan" /> in [[3950 BBY]]<ref name="Death" /> for a meeting with the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. The Emperor promptly [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Dark Councilors mere [[Time/Legends|hours]] before his [[Imperial Guard]] [[Purge of the Dark Council|purged]] the remaining three, including [[Darth Nyriss]], because five of the Councilors had participated in a [[Nathema conspiracy|conspiracy against the Emperor]].<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Igrol was first mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.<ref name="Revan" />
